issue.title: just check fails at lint (test waits): tests/test_sase_core_wheel_cache_tool.py:490 fixed sleep missing pragma
issue.description:
`just check` fails at `lint (test waits)` (`just _lint-test-waits`, `tools/check_test_wait_helpers`) with:

```
tests/test_sase_core_wheel_cache_tool.py:490: fixed-sleep-missing-pragma
```

Line 490 is the `time.sleep(0.01)` inside the `while not counter.exists() and time.monotonic() < deadline:` poll loop. The gate says positive literal test sleeps must carry an inline `# sase-test-wait: <reason>` pragma or be replaced by an observable wait. The file was last touched by adebe400d ("cache xprompt lsp build artifacts").

Found while verifying an unrelated plan-approval tale at master 4858f20a2. It fails deterministically and is independent of the tale's diff, which touches no test-wait code. `just check` stops earlier at the mypy gate on a separate bug, so run `just _lint-test-waits` directly to see this one.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic static lint finding on a literal time.sleep(0.01) with no pragma; tools/check_test_wait_helpers reports the same file:line on every run and no local change touches test-wait code.
